people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.
translations.bsb: And when Saul learned that David had fled to Gath, he no longer searched for him.
translations.kjv: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.
translations.asv: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.
